cases.proves_bugs: BUG-223 CDEDIT branch only; BUG-686 Edit Pipe zero-level branch only; BUG-1222 later plain Save regression. The CD branches are not covered. Detail: BUG-223 (CDEDIT on a pipe between two open ends, levels typed the other way round: the flow arrow follows the levels, the pipe is not left uphill without a plain warning); BUG-686 (the same with a level of exactly 0.00: the arrow follows the levels). BUG-261, BUG-292 and the size-only save are in R32b, not here.
cases.title: Edit Pipe on a pipe with two free ends: levels typed the other way round turn the flow arrow, also with a level of exactly 0.00, and the IL texts follow the typed levels
cases.plan_item: Edit Pipe single save (triage group K3; daily card D17 neighbour); BUG-223, BUG-686
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-223 (steps: draw a pipe between two open ends, CDEDIT it, type the levels the other way round: not uphill without a plain warning) and BUG-686 (CD or Edit Pipe flow arrow, a level of exactly 0.00: the arrow follows the levels) as written in BUG_CARPARK.md.
cases.expected: A new 20 m pipe with free ends and levels 18.000 / 17.800 has its flow arrow pointing from the first end to the second (arrow block rotation 0). CDEDIT with the levels typed 17.800 / 18.000 and Save prints "Pipe updated." and turns the arrow round (rotation about 3.1416: the pipe now falls from its second end), or says in plain words that the pipe flows uphill; it never ends uphill with no word. The same for a second pipe drawn 0.50 / 0.00 and edited to 0.00 / 0.50. The IL texts read the typed levels at the ends (IL 17.800 left and IL 18.000 right; IL 0.00 left and IL 0.50 right). No CE window is left open and the drawing file on disk is unchanged. Second, independent check (batch 3 review, 25 Oct): the left IL text (17.800 and 0.00) sits west of the pipe's middle (x below 160000) and the right one (18.000 and 0.50) east of it, and after a SECOND plain Edit Pipe save (nothing typed) the arrow is still turned round (rotation about 3.1416), so the first turn was a real change of direction, not only a redraw. On Civil 3.0.75 that last check is expected to FAIL: BUG-1222 (a later save turns the flipped arrow back).
cases.why_not_unit: The levels, the arrow block and the IL texts are rewritten by the live Edit Pipe save into the real drawing.
not_automated: Which way the arrow points is read from the arrow block rotation (0 = along the drawn direction, about 3.1416 = turned round); that the picture looks right is a Codex look. The size-only save is in R32b. BUG-261 and BUG-292 (a CD direction question, a plain save reversing a downstream-first pipe) are not claimed here. Pipes on pits (levels from the pits) are not driven.

cases.proves_bugs: BUG-1222 size-only Save branch; the later plain Save branch is R32. BUG-260, BUG-261 and BUG-292 are related, not proved.
cases.title: A diameter-only save in Edit Pipe keeps the flow arrow where it was, also on a pipe whose levels were typed the other way round
cases.plan_item: Edit Pipe size-only Save after reversing two free-end levels; BUG-1222
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-292 (a downstream-first pipe could be reversed by a plain Save), BUG-261 (size-only save of a two-free-end pipe whose arrow follows the levels) and BUG-260 (arrow, labels and header disagree) as written in BUG_CARPARK.md. The reversed state is reached through Edit Pipe, not through the CD direction question as in BUG-261, the owner is BUG-1222 (filed 25 Oct 2026); BUG-260, BUG-261 and BUG-292 are related, not proved (BUG-261 starts through the CD direction question, BUG-292 concerns absent stored drawn-end levels, BUG-260 includes pits and the schedule).
cases.expected: Pipe A (two free ends, 18.000 / 17.800) is edited to 17.800 / 18.000 (arrow turns round, rotation about 3.1416). A second CDEDIT of pipe A that changes only the diameter to 150 and saves prints "Pipe updated.", leaves the arrow turned round (rotation about 3.1416), both IL texts as they were (IL 17.800 left, IL 18.000 right) and the label reading "150 DIA.". Control: pipe B (never reversed) keeps its arrow at rotation 0 on the same diameter-only save. The drawing file on disk is unchanged. The left IL text of pipe A (17.800) sits west of the middle (x below 160000) and the right one (18.000) east of it. BUG-1222 (filed 25 Oct 2026, OPEN): on Civil 3.0.75 the arrow goes back to rotation 0 after the diameter-only save, so this case is expected to FAIL on the arrow checks.
cases.why_not_unit: The arrow block, the IL texts and the label are rewritten by the live Edit Pipe save into the real drawing.
not_automated: That the picture of the arrow looks right is a Codex look. Pipes on pits (levels from the pits) are not driven.
